native_contract.reset: dataset initial robot_obs and scene_obs; fresh env.reset and private start_info for each trial

provenance.selection: For each sorted task, sort native validation annotation segments by (start,end,index); greedily accept segment when start > previous selected end; choose first four non-overlapping intervals. No scoring or expert replay. Development selector, not native checkpoint task_to_id_dict.
provenance.selection_scope: 136 independent simulator resets, four disjoint annotated source intervals per task; not statistical independence, not checkpoint task_to_id_dict parity, not official 1000-sequence aggregation

archive.verification: exact HTTP byte ranges and ETag; per-member native ZIP CRC32, decompressed length, and locally computed SHA256; no whole-archive hash claim
